findings.text: The graph plots the virtual outside node at its -1.007007610773198 Wb sentinel, forcing a roughly -1.05..+0.22 Wb axis while all real nodes lie within about 0.01 Wb of zero. Omit the virtual sentinel from the numeric signed-flux axis and represent its outside attachment explicitly; do not use a broken axis, which would still make a sentinel look like a physical flux datum.

Straight dotted edges across the poloidal panel read as geometric paths or field lines, although they encode contour-tree adjacency only. Remove them from the spatial panel (the right graph already carries topology), or label them directly as non-spatial topological adjacency; the caption currently says only that they are dashed between nodes.
